description:
Jump into a vibrant world of floating platforms, tricky obstacles and fast-paced challenges in this addictive hyper-casual platformer.

Take control of a charming cube and hop your way across a variety of handcrafted levels filled with narrow pathways, moving hazards and clever routes that will put your timing and precision to the test. Every stage offers a new challenge as you leap from block to block, avoid deadly spikes, cross crumbling platforms, dodge fireballs, swing past massive hammers and overcome many more obstacles standing in your way.

Collect coins throughout your adventure and use them to unlock a growing collection of unique cube skins, allowing you to customise your character and show off your style as you progress through the game.

As your journey continues, you'll encounter the Evil Square Ones, powerful rivals that await in exciting boss battles. These action-packed encounters will challenge everything you've learned and reward skilful play.

With simple controls, satisfying gameplay and a steady stream of short, engaging levels, this is the perfect game to pick up for a quick challenge or settle in for a longer session. Easy to learn but difficult to master, every jump counts as you work your way through increasingly demanding stages.

Can you conquer every level, defeat the Evil Square Ones and become the ultimate platforming champion?
